reasoning: The requirement that all 13 vertices belong to vertex‑disjoint cliques of size 4 is impossible because 13 is not a multiple of 4. Hence no graph can satisfy all the given constraints.
cot_trace: We need exactly 1 vertex-disjoint clique of size 4? "consists of exactly 1 vertex-disjoint cliques of size 4 (every vertex belongs to one of these cliques, and the only edges are within these cliques)." That sounds contradictory: 13 vertices, cliques of size 4, vertex-disjoint, every vertex belongs to one of these cliques. 13 not divisible by 4, impossible. So UNSAT.
